correctness.rationale: The decomposition DA_m=H+R+E+F is exact. E is trace class by a convergent k^-2 sum, F finite rank, and disjoint rank-m cross-boundary pieces have counting coefficient <=mM/B. For fixed block length, direct-sum counting gives the normalized trace norm of a finite Toeplitz block. The cyclic boundary has rank at most m, so this converges to the Fourier-symbol |a_m| average. Ky Fan counting inequalities and B->infinity establish the polynomial case; the absolutely summable tail satisfies s_n(D(A-A_m))<=delta_m/n, giving the infinite case. Monotone inversion proves n*s_n->c>0. At a_j=t^j the symbol and elliptic-integral algebra are exact. Checked endpoints and 240x240 numerical sections; no computation is used for infinity.

value.rationale: The exact leading coefficient is a natural unknown spectral invariant of the compact generalized Cesàro family studied in the qualifying primary literature; compactness and eigenvalues do not fix singular-value decay for nonnormal operators. It yields an exact logarithmic trace growth constant and proves sharp membership at the weak trace-class endpoint, with a nontrivial explicit dependence on t. The proof exposes a reusable block/circulant mechanism rather than a numerical coincidence.
